title: Masked AI call forces Parkview High into soft lockdown

reports.title: Parkview High receives 4th AI-generated bomb threat this year
Hoax phone call at Gwinnett high school causes lockdown; campus cleared
Masked AI call forces Parkview High into soft lockdown

summary:
Parkview High School in Gwinnett County, Georgia received its fourth AI-generated bomb threat of the school year on Monday. School officials placed the campus on lockdown out of an abundance of caution, and normal operations later resumed. In a letter to parents, school police said the latest threat followed a pattern seen in recent incidents, which involved the use of a masked phone number.

Gwinnett County school police are now working with the Georgia Bureau of Investigation and the FBI to determine who is responsible for the threats. Investigators are looking for the source of the threats. No arrests have been made and no suspect has been identified. The investigation is ongoing, and authorities have not announced any further steps.
